fact.en: Confusing the Eightfold Path with the Four Noble Truths. The Path is the fourth Truth (Magga).
fact.hi: Confusing the Eightfold Path with the Four Noble Truths. The Path is the fourth Truth (Magga).

fact.en: Assuming the Path is only for monks; historically, Buddha preached the 'middle path' for laypeople as well to achieve a better rebirth.
fact.hi: Assuming the Path is only for monks; historically, Buddha preached the 'middle path' for laypeople as well to achieve a better rebirth.

fact.en: Equating 'Right Action' strictly with non-violence (Ahimsa), though non-violence is core, the path includes specific ethical conduct regarding theft and sexual behavior.
